data.title: ‘The End of Times’ Is an AI-Assisted Film Essay on Trauma That Wants to “Politicize Mental Illness” (Exclusive Venice Trailer)
data.description: Salomé searches through decades of family footage for the reasons for her mother’s sadness in Bibiana Rojas Gómez and Juan David Cárdenas Maldonado's film, premiering in the Venice Critics' Week.
data.author: Georg Szalai
